name: Gedaliah
summary: Gedaliah son of Ahikam was made governor by the king of Babylon over the people left in Judah after Jerusalem fell. He told them to settle in the land, but he would not believe a warning about a plot and was killed at Mizpah.

key_moments.title: Urges the Captains to Serve Babylon
key_moments.description: Jeremiah came to live with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the captains came to him too. Gedaliah swore to them that if they settled in the land and served the king of Babylon, all would be well, and Jews came back from many lands.

key_moments.title: Refuses to Believe Johanan's Warning
key_moments.description: Johanan son of Kareah warned Gedaliah that Ishmael had been sent to kill him, and secretly offered to kill Ishmael first. Gedaliah refused and said Johanan was speaking falsely about Ishmael.

key_moments.title: Killed at Mizpah
key_moments.description: Ishmael son of Nethaniah came with ten men and ate bread with Gedaliah at Mizpah. Then they rose up and killed him with the sword, along with the Jews and Chaldeans who were there.
